dataset: MGH CDMD sub_013, tracked for Planum
subject: sub_013

tracking.procedure: scripts/cdmd_pilot.py: MSMT-CSD (DIPY), particle filtering tractography, RecoBundles against DIPY's HCP842 80-bundle atlas; every file whose method is RecoBundles
tracking.recognition_rng: each recognition from the post-construction state of default_rng(2001)

tractseg.peaks: MRtrix3 3.0.8: dwi2response dhollander, dwi2fod msmt_csd, sh2peaks (TractSeg csd_msmt)

mni_alignment.method: mrregister -type rigid of tensor FA (b = 0, 800, 1500) to TractSeg's MNI_FA_template; FODs moved with mrtransform -reorient_fod yes

tractseg.tracking: TractSeg probabilistic TOM tracking, 2,000 streamlines per bundle

fa.resampling: trilinear onto the T1 grid through dwi_to_t1_world

runtime_workarounds.single_openmp: torch, dipy and scikit-learn each bundle libomp 5.0; dipy's and scikit-learn's are symlinks to torch's, so one runtime loads. KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK is not used.
runtime_workarounds.fork_start_method: TractSeg's Tracking passes worker state through module globals, which only reach workers under fork; it runs through a wrapper that selects it.

processing: Every streamline kept and resampled to 0.5 mm arc-length steps by linear interpolation; the T1 is the reconstruction's pinned input, unchanged, and FA is the tensor FA of the subject's own diffusion scan resampled onto it.
spatial_validation: Map shape and affine agree with every TRK header at absolute tolerance 1e-5.
geometry_validation: NiBabel RAS+ millimetre samples and float64 polyline lengths provide independent checks of the browser's TRK decoder.
